title: [observability] The Fleet page's Core lines diagnostics say which fall Free disk lost a day is: the week's fit or the last day's fall (storage.disk_fall's basis since 222, after its name; rev-e's n1 on 222)
prompt:
Spawn, objective 225 [observability] (the lead's ask of 2026-11-19 03:35, mission 4's next core contract: rev-e's n1 on 222; author rev-h; readers rev-j, then rev-k): the Fleet page's Core lines diagnostics say which fall "Free disk lost a day" is, the week's fit or the last day's fall, after its name.

The problem. Since objective 222 (landed 38c3a263, fleet c99302e1), storage.disk_fall is the worse of the week's least-squares fit and the last day's fall, and GET /api/core-lines says which one in the figure's `basis` ("fit" or "day"). The page drops it: web/src/coreLines.ts's coreLinesView names the diagnostic "Free disk lost a day" whatever its basis, and the Fleet page's health strip shows that name beside the value. So on 2026-11-18 the owner would read "Free disk lost a day 77.1 GB" with no way to tell it is one day's fall (sweeps had lifted the week's line to a gain), and "1 day left" beside it without the reason.

Read first: web/src/coreLines.ts (CoreFigure, mark, its name helpers windowWords, storeWords, judgedWords), web/test/coreLines.test.ts ("a figure that names its store says it after its name", objective 141), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/disk.rs's module doc (what the two falls are).

What changes (web/src only):
- CoreFigure gains `basis?: string` (the answer's field since 222).
- mark() says it after the figure's name, beside the store and the window, as storeWords does: " (the week's fit)" for "fit", " (the last day's fall)" for "day"; nothing without a basis, for null, or for a value it does not know (the name as before).
- No other figure carries a basis today (222 sets it on storage.disk_fall only), so no other name changes.

What stays as it is: every other figure's name, value, range, target and tone; the rows, readings and diagnostics and their order; the trend; the server and its answer (no crate change); the page's layout (the name is the same span, longer).

Files: web/src/coreLines.ts, web/test/coreLines.test.ts. Owner: rsi/scenarios/225.sh, rsi/backlog/225.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/225.sh, black box: a real `spawn serve` on its own database, hourly host.core_lines samples planted as a loop records them against the free disk F the serve reads (222.sh's harness), each answer of GET /api/core-lines read through web/src/coreLines.ts's coreLinesView under node, as the page does:
- (1) a week rising 10 GB a day up to F + 80 GB a day ago, then falling through the last day to F (the answer's basis "day"): the diagnostic is named "Free disk lost a day (the last day's fall)";
- (2) a week falling 10 GB a day, then a day gaining 10 GB (basis "fit"): "Free disk lost a day (the week's fit)";
- (3) no sample (no value, no basis): "Free disk lost a day";
- (4) in each, no other figure on the card (rows, readings, diagnostics) says either basis's words, and no figure's value or range says them (the basis is beside the name, never in the value).
The answer's basis in each case is checked first as a harness fact (222's behaviour). On live main c99302e1, 225.sh exits 1 at (1) and (2).

Tests (unit, web/test/coreLines.test.ts): "the free disk lost a day says its basis after its name": "day", "fit", none, null and an unknown value. No test is renamed or dropped.

Verified by: after landing, the Fleet page's Core lines diagnostics on live name "Free disk lost a day" with the basis /api/core-lines gives (the lead's look).
